categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies Guix build scripts under contrib/guix/libexec/ and carries the Build system label.
categories.rationale: Fixes mixed relative and absolute paths in Guix debug symbols by mapping the full source tree instead of only src/. As noted in issue #34414, generated sources in the build directory previously retained absolute build container paths, creating friction when setting up source directory mapping in debuggers like gdb.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Guix build scripts belong to build and release rather than tools; the tools category specifically notes that build and release scripts belong to build.
categories.rationale: Non-member; Guix build scripts are covered under build.
